build_sizer_for_bmg_graph: build a Sizer instance to compute tensor sizes for all nodes in a BMG graph
compute_broadcast_size: compute the broadcast size of multiple tensor sizes using the _broadcast function
check_scalar_nodes: check if a BMG node type is always scalar using the _always_scalar set
determine_matrix_multiplication_size: determine the output size of a MatrixMultiplicationNode by calling _size_mm on a Sizer
validate_node_size_consistency: validate that all branch outputs of a ChoiceNode or IfThenElseNode have consistent sizes
